items.note: 并提出「play 是辅元辅结构，为什么不双写」——已在批改段答疑：ay 是元音字母组合，y 在此作元音，不构成辅元辅，故不双写。

items.targetPoint: 辅音字母 + y 改 y 为 i 再加 -ed

items.userAnswer: Last week, I played games with my friend. I teached my friend to use AI. I getted more knowledge about English. I cooked two breakfasts. I watched short movies.
items.revisedAnswer: Last week, I played games with my friend. I taught my friend to use AI. I learned more about English. I cooked breakfast for my family. I watched short movies.
items.errorNote: 两处：①语法——teached → taught，teach 是不规则动词（第 2 次犯，上次第 6 课）；②语法——getted → got，get 也是不规则动词；想说「学到知识」更自然的说法是 I learned more about English。用词建议（不计错）：I cooked two breakfasts 语法无误但语义像「同一天两份早餐」，想说做了两次用 I cooked breakfast twice.。达标项：played games / short movies 可数名词全部加 s（P0 自查项通过），时间标志词 Last week 已用，5 句数量达标。
items.targetPoint: 不规则动词过去式 + 可数名词复数

mistakeCandidates.wrongText: I teached my friend to use AI
mistakeCandidates.correctText: I taught my friend to use AI
mistakeCandidates.errorReason: teach 是不规则动词，过去式是 taught，不是加 -ed（第 2 次犯，首次在第 6 课）
get 是不规则动词，过去式是 got，不能加 -ed；想表达「学到」更常用 learned

summary.note: 错误处数按 §11.4：teached、getted 各 1 处；blank 与用词建议不计入
